project: Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 PC Port
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue
notes: Native Windows build with the TRG launcher, high frame rates, local achievements and offline leaderboards. Experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage, not yet tested on real hardware. First public release (0.1.0) is pending
